changelog:
Initial release of GitHub Smart Code Digest.

- Automates code review for GitHub repositories with AI-driven, multi-dimensional analysis (correctness, security, maintainability, performance, compliance).
- Generates visual summary cards and detailed review pages for each report.
- Publishes comprehensive code review digests to Feishu Wiki, supporting scheduled daily/weekly delivery.
- Filters low-impact PRs and highlights only high-confidence issues for actionable insights.
- Designed for engineering teams, technical leads, and open source maintainers to streamline code quality tracking and reporting.
summary: GitHub Smart Code Digest — 自动监控仓库 Commits/PRs，AI 智能代码审查， 生成可视化审查卡片，汇总发布到飞书 Wiki。适用于团队代码质量追踪和工程管理者日报/周报生成。 触发词：代码审查报告、GitHub 监控、PR 审查日报、代码质量汇总、工程师日报。
